decision: Selected the planar centroid of the union of the four Cumberland County tax parcels held by Carlisle Development Partners LLC at 246, 248, 250 and 256 Country Club Road, Middlesex Township (692.97 geodesic acres, sale date 15 July 2025), whose combined area matches the 693-acre PAX-1 campus PowerHouse publishes, as the campus locator replacing the imported Middlesex Township point.
layer: Cumberland County, Pennsylvania ArcGIS Online feature layer 'Tax_Parcels' (gis_ccpa organisation, FeatureServer layer 0), queried by owner name and requested in WGS84 (outSR 4326)

facts.centroid_method: shapely planar centroid of the union in WGS84 longitude/latitude; the EPSG:32618 planar centroid transformed back differs by 0.04 m
facts.sale_date_cross_check: SALEDATE 1752537600000 ms = 2025-07-15T00:00:00Z on all four parcels, the date of PowerHouse's announcement of the Carlisle joint venture
facts.area_cross_check: union 692.97 geodesic acres (CalcAcre sum 692.91; deeded 694.15); PowerHouse PAX-1 page 'Acreage: 693 Acres'; joint-venture release 'Approximately 700-acre site'
facts.tax_district_cross_check: all four parcels lie in Middlesex Township and the Cumberland Valley School District, the bodies the joint-venture release names as recipients of the project's tax revenue

exclusions: Neighbouring parcels held by other owners are not part of the union and their owner names are not reproduced. Sale prices and the owner's mailing address are not reproduced. No geocoder, map viewport or township centre is used.
